description: Latest official rule changes we detected, K-beauty recalls and alerts, and newly checked products (up to 10). Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA) say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
name: recent_updates
